lines.en: label shrine20:
scene shrinetwenty1
I arrive at the shrine to find Maya taking a break from whatever it is shrine maidens do every day, calmly sitting on a rock and not paying much attention to anything.
lines.zh: 我来到神社，发现 Maya 正从巫女每天要做的那些事里抽身休息，平静地坐在一块石头上，对周围的一切都不太在意。

lines.en: She stares up at the sun as its rays leak through the trees and find their way onto her dress, illuminating her body and turning her almost angelic in nature.
lines.zh: 她仰头望着太阳，阳光透过树叶漏下来，落在她的法衣上，照亮她的身体，让她几乎带上了天使般的性质。

lines.en: Though, I highly doubt angels are as confrontational as her.
lines.zh: 不过，我很怀疑天使会像她这么爱找茬。

lines.en: Ideally, an angel wouldn’t accuse you of sleeping around with [teenage]girls on a daily basis.
lines.zh: 理想情况下，天使应该不会天天指控你和[teenage]女孩乱搞。

lines.en: Or call you a disgusting waste of life in the middle of every conversation.
lines.zh: 也不会在每次谈话说到一半时，叫你一声令人作呕的废物。

lines.en: But I guess beggars can’t be choosers, and I am very much a beggar.
lines.zh: 不过我想，乞丐没资格挑三拣四，而我就是个不折不扣的乞丐。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty2
: Oh, look. A pervert.
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧。一个变态。

lines.en: : Please leave me alone or I'll be forced to call security.
lines.zh: : 请离我远点，不然我就不得不叫保安了。

lines.en: : Hey, Maya.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Maya。

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Goodbye, now.
lines.zh: : 再见吧，现在。

lines.en: : Not goodbye. I’m here to talk to you.
lines.zh: : 不是再见。我是来跟你说话的。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty3
: About what, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体要说什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Probably something that I don’t possess enough intellect to comprehend or follow along with.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。大概是某种我智商不够、理解不了也跟不上的东西。

lines.en: : So a normal conversation for you.
lines.zh: : 那就是你的日常对话咯。

lines.en: : Yeah, exactly.
lines.zh: : 对，就是这样。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 是吗。

lines.en: : Well, I’m not exactly in a talking mood. So maybe we should just save this for another day?
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不太想说话。所以也许我们该改天再聊？

lines.en: : You’re never in a talking mood.
lines.zh: : 你从来没有想说话的时候。

lines.en: : That’s not true.
lines.zh: : 才不是。

lines.en: : We had a lengthy discussion about stars on the beach just recently.
lines.zh: : 我们前不久还在海滩上聊了很久的星星呢。

lines.en: : Or perhaps you’ve already forgotten that?
lines.zh: : 还是说你已经忘了？

lines.en: My mind races back to when I found Maya alone on the shore just an hour or two before Rin’s heart was snapped in half.
lines.zh: 我的思绪飞回我在岸边独自找到 Maya 的那次，就在 Rin 的心被撕成两半之前的一两个小时。

lines.en: A lot happened that day, so the conversation is a little foggy, but what I do remember is that it...
lines.zh: 那天发生了太多事，那次对话已经有点模糊了，但我记得的是它……

lines.en: Well, it was just another conversation with Maya.
lines.zh: 嗯，那不过是又一次和 Maya 的对话罢了。

lines.en: : Not entirely. I remember that you like stars.
lines.zh: : 不完全是。我还记得你喜欢星星。

lines.en: : Yes. An important character trait.
lines.zh: : 是的。一个重要的性格特征。

lines.en: : Take note of that in your journal.
lines.zh: : 请把这条记进你的日记里。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll put it right next to “Hates my guts” and “Likes watermelons.”
lines.zh: : 好。我会把它写在「恨我入骨」和「喜欢西瓜」旁边。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty4
: I don’t think “Hate” even begins to describe my feelings toward you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得「恨」这个字根本不足以描述我对你的感情。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’ll just scratch that part out and fill it with a bunch of question marks, then.
lines.zh: : 没事。那我就把那部分划掉，填上一堆问号好了。

lines.en: : Thank you. I’d also edit your entry in my journal, but I was afraid it would begin to bleed into the other pages, so I already tore it out and set it on fire.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我也想改一改我那页，可我怕它会渗到别的页上去，所以我早就把它撕下来烧了。

lines.en: : That’s rude.
lines.zh: : 真没礼貌。

lines.en: : It burned up very quickly.
lines.zh: : 它烧得特别快。

lines.en: : Thanks. That’s a thing I wanted to know.
lines.zh: : 谢了。这我确实想知道。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty3
: That aside, has anything else changed since you’ve come back from vacation?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你度假回来之后还有什么别的变化吗？

lines.en: : The ending must have been rather eventful for you.
lines.zh: : 那个结局对你来说一定相当热闹。

lines.en: : How do you know about the ending?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道结局的事？

lines.en: : It’s hard to not overhear things when everyone is so close together.
lines.zh: : 大家挨得这么近，想不听到也难。

lines.en: : Perhaps I stumbled upon a stray conversation or two while I was out watching the stars?
lines.zh: : 也许是我出去看星星的时候，偶然撞见了一两段闲聊？

lines.en: : Such a thing could happen, could it not?
lines.zh: : 这种事是有可能发生的，不是吗？

lines.en: : It could. But I feel like things aren’t usually as they seem with you.
lines.zh: : 是有可能。但我觉得，和你有关的事往往不像表面看上去那样。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty5
: Oh?
: I’m not sure what you mean. I’m just a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 我不懂你什么意思。我只是个普通的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : Everything I say is exactly as it is. I have nothing to hide, especially from someone like you.
lines.zh: : 我说的每一句话都就是字面上的意思。我没什么好藏的，尤其是对你这种人。

lines.en: : If you have nothing to hide, then how about we talk about your past for a little while? Or your interests.
lines.zh: : 要是你没什么好藏的，那我们来聊聊你的过去怎么样？或者你的兴趣。

lines.en: : Anything to make me feel like we’re getting somewhere.
lines.zh: : 随便什么都行，只要让我觉得我们有点进展。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty6
: Maya Makinami. Age, [[redacted]. My hobbies include watermelons and the violin. My past is of none of your concern.
lines.zh: : Maya Makinami。年龄，[[redacted]。兴趣是西瓜和小提琴。我的过去与你无关。

lines.en: : Watermelons aren’t a hobby, Maya.
lines.zh: : 西瓜不是兴趣，Maya。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty2
: And stalking shrine maidens is?
lines.zh: : 那跟踪巫女就是了？

lines.en: : I’m not stalking you.
lines.zh: : 我没有跟踪你。

lines.en: : Yes you are. I was enjoying my break and you just showed up and started asking me questions about myself.
lines.zh: : 你就是。我正享受休息时间，你就冒出来开始问我关于我自己的问题。

lines.en: : What are you even taking a break from? All you do is sweep.
lines.zh: : 你到底是在从什么事里休息？你整天就只是扫地而已。

lines.en: : Then I suppose I am taking a break from sweeping.
lines.zh: : 那我大概就是在从扫地里休息吧。

lines.en: : Are we done now? Or are you going to pester me more?
lines.zh: : 现在可以了吗？还是你打算继续烦我？

lines.en: : I’m going to pester you more.
lines.zh: : 我打算继续烦你。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty6
: Of course you are.
lines.zh: : 你当然会。

lines.en: Maya lets out a heavy sigh and squeezes her arm.
lines.zh: Maya 重重地叹了口气，攥紧了自己的手臂。

lines.en: I can feel her getting annoyed, but I doubt it’s any more annoyed than {i}I{/i} am having to keep up with her all the time.
lines.zh: {i}我{/i}能感觉到她在生气，不过我怀疑，她再怎么生气，也不会比「我」一直得跟上她的节奏更让人恼火。

lines.en: : How was vacation for you? Other than spending the bulk of your second night watching the stars, I mean.
lines.zh: : 你假期过得怎么样？我是说，除了第二天晚上大半时间都在看星星之外。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty2
: I wasn’t very fond of the part where you walked in on me getting changed, but other than that it was fine.
lines.zh: : 我撞见我换衣服那部分我不太喜欢，不过除此之外都还好。

lines.en: : That was actually one of my favorite parts of the whole weekend.
lines.zh: : 那其实是整个周末里我最喜欢的片段之一。

lines.en: : You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : And yes, I know I’ve said that many times now.
lines.zh: : 还有，对，我知道这话我已经说过很多次了。

lines.en: : You create too many opportunities.
lines.zh: : 你制造了太多机会。

lines.en: : You should try being less horrible.
lines.zh: : 你该试着别那么烂。

lines.en: : But then I wouldn’t be me.
lines.zh: : 可那样我就不是我了。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty7
: That’s debatable.
lines.zh: : 那可不好说。

lines.en: : You still don’t even know who {i}you{/i} are. Isn’t that right?
lines.zh: : 你连「你」{i}自己{/i}是谁都还不知道。对吧？

lines.en: : You’re right, I don’t. And, to be honest, it’s pretty hard figuring that out without any help.
lines.zh: : 你说得对，我不知道。说实话，在没有任何帮助的情况下，很难搞清楚这件事。

lines.en: : You’d think if you really wanted me to succeed at this whole ‘reincarnation’ thing, you might actually help me.
lines.zh: : 你要是真想让我把「转世」这件事做成，按理说你总该帮帮我吧。

lines.en: : Given that you’re the one person who seems to know what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 毕竟你是唯一一个看起来知道发生了什么的人。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty2
: You succeeding only makes things harder for me.
lines.zh: : 你成功只会让我的事更难办。

lines.en: : I need you to fail to a certain degree.
lines.zh: : 我需要在一定程度上让你失败。

lines.en: : Also, I’d appreciate it if you’d stop assuming that I know what’s going on.
lines.zh: : 还有，要是你能别再一口咬定我知道发生了什么，我会很感激。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty7
: I told you this on the beach, but this world isn’t something I have complete control over. I just know how to manipulate certain parts of it to make things easier.
lines.zh: : 我在海滩上跟你说过了，这个世界不是我能完全掌控的东西。我只是知道怎么操纵它的某些部分，好让事情变得容易些。

lines.en: : If “easier” is even the right word to describe it.
lines.zh: : 如果「容易」还算是个合适的词的话。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I don’t think it is.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我觉得不是。

lines.en: : I’m lost again.
lines.zh: : 我又听不懂了。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty5
: We’re all lost.
lines.zh: : 我们都很迷路。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t mean we can’t find our way.
lines.zh: : 可那不代表我们找不到路。

lines.en: : We just need to follow the appropriate steps.
lines.zh: : 我们只需要遵循适当的步骤。

lines.en: : And I’m assuming those steps involve not getting closer to you.
lines.zh: : 而我猜，那些步骤里包括不要和你走得太近。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty8
: Perhaps they do. Perhaps they don’t.
lines.zh: : 也许是。也许不是。

lines.en: : What would I know? I’m just a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 我又能知道什么？我只是个普通的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : A normal [teenage]girl with a set of very abnormal circumstances.
lines.zh: : 一个处境极不寻常的普通[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : There’s a difference between abnormal circumstances and horrible luck.
lines.zh: : 处境不寻常和运气糟糕是两回事。

lines.en: : Though, I suppose I’ve been blessed with both.
lines.zh: : 不过，我想我两者都占全了。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty9
: If you knew when the world was going to end, what would you do about it?
lines.zh: : 如果你知道世界什么时候会终结，你会怎么做？

lines.en: : Is this about the reset thing?
lines.zh: : 这是在说那件重置的事吗？

lines.en: : Perhaps it is. Perhaps it isn’t.
lines.zh: : 也许是。也许不是。

lines.en: : Well, knowing what would happen {i}after{/i} the end of the world would play a big part in determining that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，知道世界终结「{i}之后{/i}」会发生什么，对判断这一点影响很大。

lines.en: : If I didn’t know the world would just be starting over again, I’d probably spend my last days making sure I don’t have any regrets.
lines.zh: : 如果我不知道世界会重新开始，我大概会用最后的日子确保自己不留遗憾。

lines.en: : But, if I know things are just going to start over, I don’t think I’d change much at all.
lines.zh: : 可如果我知道一切都会重来，我想我不会改变什么。

lines.en: : No. You wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 不。你不会。

lines.en: : You’d keep doing everything exactly the same way while everyone else faces the apocalypse.
lines.zh: : 当其他所有人都面对末日的时候，你还是会照旧做每一件事。

lines.en: : Then, you’d watch as a new world forms and fills back up with everything you’ve grown to know over your time there.
lines.zh: : 然后，你会看着一个新世界成形，重新填满你在那里度过的时光里所熟知的每一件事物。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty6
: But then, that begins to raise questions.
lines.zh: : 不过那样一来，就开始引出问题了。

lines.en: : Is the new world that generates the same as the old one?
lines.zh: : 生成的那个新世界，和旧的是同一个吗？

lines.en: : If all of the buildings and structures stay the same, but the people filling them are all replaced with identical copies equipped with altered minds, can we still call it the same world?
lines.zh: : 如果所有的建筑和结构都保持不变，可住在里面的人全被换成了装着被改写心智的相同复制品，我们还能把它叫作同一个世界吗？

lines.en: : I guess that depends on how much of a person’s worth is tied to their memories.
lines.zh: : 我想，那取决于一个人的价值有多少是和他的记忆绑在一起的。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty2
: That’s a surprisingly insightful answer. Please explain yourself.
lines.zh: : 这答案出乎意料地有见地。请解释一下。

lines.en: : Well, after the first reset, everything felt exactly the same.
lines.zh: : 嗯，第一次重置之后，一切感觉完全相同。

lines.en: : It was like the only thing that actually changed was where we were in time.
lines.zh: : 就像唯一真正改变的，只是我们在时间中所处的位置。

lines.en: : But the only people that seem to realize that are you and me.
lines.zh: : 可似乎只有你和我意识到了这一点。

lines.en: : Is that what you believe?
lines.zh: : 你就是这么相信的吗？

lines.en: : Is that not the case?
lines.zh: : 难道不是吗？

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty7
: I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。

lines.en: : It’s a confusing situation.
lines.zh: : 这是个令人困惑的局面。

lines.en: : Pretty soon, the seasons will change.
lines.zh: : 很快，季节就要变了。

lines.en: : We’ll be walking to[school] in the snow instead of the sun, and yet no one will think anything of it.
lines.zh: : 我们会在雪里而不是阳光下走去[school]，却没有一个人觉得有什么不对。

lines.en: : No one but us.
lines.zh: : 除了我们。

lines.en: : Why is that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Something about the way time flows here is different than it should be.
lines.zh: : 这里时间的流动方式，和它本该有的样子不一样。

lines.en: Wait, will everyone really just be acting normal once winter comes?
lines.zh: 等等，等冬天来了，大家真的都会表现得像平常一样吗？

lines.en: I know it’s right around the corner, but I figured there’d at least be some sort of reaction from people when we get there.
lines.zh: 我知道冬天近在眼前，但我以为至少会有人在我们走到那一步的时候有点反应。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty9
: But I guess things like that don’t particularly matter to you, do they?
lines.zh: : 不过我想，那种事对你来说并不特别重要吧？

lines.en: : You’re just here to advance yourself.
lines.zh: : 你只是来这儿推进你自己的。

lines.en: : You’ll treat this like it’s all just a game and, eventually, you too will reach the end.
lines.zh: : 你会把这一切当成一场游戏，然后最终，你也会走到结局。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty10
: But what happens after the credits roll?
lines.zh: : 可字幕滚完之后会发生什么？

lines.en: : What becomes of everyone inside of that game?
lines.zh: : 那个游戏里的所有人会变成什么样？

lines.en: : And what happens if they don’t reset along with the others the next time you press “Start?”
lines.zh: : 如果下次你按下「开始」的时候，他们没有跟着其他东西一起重置，又会怎样？

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty11
: I don’t know how many times I’ve said this to you, but this isn’t a game.
lines.zh: : 我不知道跟你说过多少次了，这不是游戏。

lines.en: : You only think it is.
lines.zh: : 只是你以为它是。

lines.en: Has she said that to me at all before?
lines.zh: 她以前真的跟我说过这个吗？

lines.en: I can’t remember...
lines.zh: 我不记得了……

lines.en: : Who says that I think this is a game?
lines.zh: : 谁说我觉得这是游戏了？

lines.en: : It's true that, at first, I may have approached it as one.
lines.zh: : 没错，一开始我也许确实是把它当游戏来对待的。

lines.en: : But as time goes by, I’m beginning to think that this is where I belong.
lines.zh: : 可随着时间的推移，我开始觉得，这里才是我归属的地方。

lines.en: : I’ll admit that I haven’t been here all that long in the grand scheme of things, but the progress I’ve made with everyone is real.
lines.zh: : 我承认，从大局来看我在这儿待的时间并不长，但我和大家之间取得的进展是真实的。

lines.en: : Isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty6
: Obviously, I won’t know the answer to that.
lines.zh: : 显然，我不会知道那个问题的答案。

lines.en: : It’s up to you to figure out what is real and what isn’t.
lines.zh: : 什么是真实、什么不是，得由你自己去弄明白。

lines.en: : I’ve already come up with my answer, but you need to learn to think for yourself.
lines.zh: : 我已经有了自己的答案，但你需要学会自己思考。

lines.en: : If something feels real to you, then it’s probably real.
lines.zh: : 如果某样东西对你来说感觉真实，那它大概就是真实的。

lines.en: : But, knowing the type of person you are now, I can’t imagine anything will ever feel that way again.
lines.zh: : 不过，照你现在这种人的性子，我无法想象还会有什么东西能再让你有那种感觉。

lines.en: : You feel real to me.
lines.zh: : 你对我来说是真实的。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty5
: I’m really, {i}really{/i} tired of hearing that line.
lines.zh: : 我真的、{i}真的{/i}听腻了这句台词。

lines.en: : It was cute the first time, but now it’s just getting annoying.
lines.zh: : 第一次说的时候挺可爱，现在就只剩烦人了。

lines.en: : How many times have you heard it exactly?
lines.zh: : 你到底听过多少次了？

lines.en: : Almost the same amount of times I’ve heard that one.
lines.zh: : 差不多和那一句一样多。

lines.en: : And the one you’ll say after that.
lines.zh: : 还有你接下来要说的那一句。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty8
: Sure, there are some minor changes here and there, but everything follows the same pattern for the most part.
lines.zh: : 当然，这里那里会有一些小变化，但大体上一切都遵循同一个模式。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty12
: It’s all part of the cycle.
lines.zh: : 那都是循环的一部分。

lines.en: : But that’s something you already know.
lines.zh: : 可那是你早就知道的事。

lines.en: : For now, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少现在是。

lines.en: : Just keep on living and forget about all of my ramblings.
lines.zh: : 继续过你的日子，忘掉我这些胡言乱语吧。

lines.en: : Frankly, I’m getting tired of having to explain myself.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我也厌倦了一遍遍解释自己。

lines.en: : Perhaps I should just let you figure things out on your own from now on?
lines.zh: : 也许从现在起，我该让你自己去弄明白？

lines.en: : Definitely don’t do that.
lines.zh: : 千万别那么做。

lines.en: : Part of me feels like I would have gotten caught in that pre-reset loop for months without your help.
lines.zh: : 我有种感觉，要是没有你的帮助，我会在那个重置前的循环里困上好几个月。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty5
: In some regard, I’m sure you already have.
lines.zh: : 从某种意义上说，我敢肯定你已经困过了。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty2
: But, now it’s time for me to get back to work.
lines.zh: : 不过，现在我该回去工作了。

lines.en: : Already? But I just got here.
lines.zh: : 这就走了？我刚到啊。

lines.en: : And you’ll be here again.
lines.zh: : 而你还会再来的。

lines.en: : To be fair, you got a lot more out of me today than you’re supposed to.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，你今天从我这儿挖到的东西，比你应该挖到的多得多。

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re rather talkative for someone who isn't in a talkative mood.
lines.zh: : 是啊，对一个说自己没心情聊天的人来说，你话还真多。

lines.en: : And you’re rather obnoxious for someone who is.
lines.zh: : 而对一个有心情聊天的人来说，你还真讨人厌。

lines.en: scene shrinetwenty12
: Oh. By the way-
lines.zh: : 哦。顺便说一句——

lines.en: : I may require your help again in the near future.
lines.zh: : 不久的将来，我可能还需要你的帮忙。

lines.en: : I hope you don’t mind carrying a few more boxes.
lines.zh: : 希望你别介意再搬几个箱子。

lines.en: scene black
Maya gets up off of the rock and begins to walk away without saying goodbye.
lines.zh: Maya 从石头上站起来，一声再见也没说就走开了。

lines.en: As confused as I am (Both about the boxes and the entire conversation we just had) I don’t call out to her.
lines.zh: 虽然我很困惑（对箱子的事、也对我们刚才整段对话），但我没有叫住她。

lines.en: She was right in saying that I got a lot more out of her today than I normally do.
lines.zh: 她说得对，今天我从她身上套到的东西比平时多得多。

lines.en: But, even with that, I still don’t feel much closer to her.
lines.zh: 可即便如此，我依然不觉得和她亲近了多少。

lines.en: I wonder if the two of us will ever meet up on the same wavelength in the future?
lines.zh: 我不知道我们两个将来会不会有一天调到同一个波长上？

lines.en: And, if so-
lines.zh: 而如果会——

lines.en: I wonder how long it will take to get there.
lines.zh: 我想知道要多久才能走到那一步。

$ shrine20 = True
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}
